messages:
nora: Urgent hotfix for embeddings-service 2.5.3 -> 2.5.4. Memory bump under burst in ap-southeast causes OOM. No DB changes. Need fast-track during 01:00-02:30 UTC window.

deploybot: CI green. Staging canary passed. Rollout plan: canary 2% -> 20% -> 100% with 3m checks. Manual approval required.

ops-oncall: I'm available. +1 if we start in ap-southeast only and have immediate rollback/pin.

jay: Kill-switch is `/deploy rollback embeddings-service --to 2.5.3 --immediate`. Also have LB pin fallback.

lee: Release note draft: "embeddings-service: fix transient memory growth under burst traffic. No changes required by clients." I'll stage it as draft.

nora: `/deploy approve 1823456789 --fasttrack`

deploybot: Approved by nora. Starting 2% canary in ap-southeast. Monitoring memory RSS, restarts, 5xx.

deploybot: Canary 2% stable after 4m. Advancing to 20%.

ops-oncall: Pause  seeing unrelated CDN config rollout causing 502 spikes. Pausing and rolling back canary groups now.

deploybot: Rollback executed; traffic pinned to 2.5.3. Health checks back to normal.

nora: Abort for now. Will reschedule once CDN rollout completes. Thanks team.
